concrete_findings.closure: _canonical_cycle now prospectively charges 6*(prefix node count + prefix edge count)+27 before concatenation and constructor visits, independently of prefix reconstruction work. Frozen-code oracle rechecks cycle behavior.

concrete_findings.issue: Absence-witness starts+frontiers+terminals concatenation repeats the earlier groups and must be prepaid as an actual copy.
